newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee opens firmer in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee opens firmer in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee opened 0.11 firmer at 41.39 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday, amid higher supplies of the U.S. currency from the Gulf, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to close stable, a dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on July 10, was 40.5200/40.7226 against the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates opened at 2.35 percent compared to the previous closing at 2.40 percent.
